authorization_context: Direct response to the request to authorize clean disposable VM/runtime preparation only, checking storage limits first, with no actual checkpoint loading or research execution.
authorized_now: prepare a clean disposable local VM and its runtime
prepare setup files and inspection checks
not_authorized_now: elevating or bypassing the Windows computer-use helper
changing host security or execution policy

actual_observations.hyper_v: Installed and administratively accessible to the user; live UI inventory empty
actual_observations.automation_boundary: Computer-use helper is lower-integrity than the elevated Hyper-V window; no privileged input is attempted.

target_guest_requirements.approved_inputs: Only individually authenticated staging members; immutable/read-only media. Real artifacts must not be staged or loaded during this preparation.
target_guest_requirements.export: Bounded data-only channel with independent validator; no guest executables or untrusted filesystem mounts on host. A serial named-pipe channel is a candidate only, not implemented or verified.
target_guest_requirements.wall_and_output_enforcement: Still requires an implemented host watchdog, guest output quota and independent channel byte cap tested on artificial data. A VM configuration alone does not provide these.

runtime_source_status.prospective_compatibility_family: Linux Python 3.10 / PyTorch 2.7.0 / torchvision 0.22.0, as already proposed in A2
runtime_source_status.cpu_conversion_variant: Possible preparation candidate only; dependency closure and saved-object compatibility must be authenticated. No silent change to the later CUDA12.6 scientific runtime or parity definition.
runtime_source_status.warning: Compressed download size is not installed or expanded VM size. Do not acquire/extract this candidate merely because its compressed listing appears small.

storage_reconciliation.no_double_counting: The local guest/runtime must occupy the existing canonical runtime reservation, not an extra local copy in addition to an independently reserved cluster runtime. All OS media, wheel caches, expanded disks, VM metadata/runtime-state files, failures and later copies require explicit reconciliation before provisioning. No original slack is released or spent here.
unresolved: future preservation topology for the canonical runtime

next_safe_step: User runs the supplied read-only preflight from an administrator PowerShell session and returns its output. Insufficient free RAM must be resolved without agent-closing applications, terminating jobs or losing unsaved work. Binary acquisition/provisioning waits for exact runtime/storage reconciliation; authorization itself is already recorded.
test_status: Dedicated syntax/read-only checks only; no claim of artificial guest round-trip or isolation enforcement.

preparation_accounting.basis: Full conservative 600-second preparation reservation for this turn's capacity checks, source/runtime metadata reads, dedicated small files and syntax/read-only verification; retained as a charge, not a measured elapsed-time claim.
